data.name: Rise of The Newborns
data.detailed_description:
It is the late 21st century. The world is dying, consumed by unchecked capitalism and technology run amok. Beset by genetic horrors, biological warfare, and a collapsing ecosystem, humanity struggles to find a way to survive. You are one of the survivors, a so-called Newborn, immune to the most devastating plague in the history of man–the Von Aegis Syndrome (VAS). You and your fellow Newborn may yet rebuild the world - if you can survive against nature, mutants, and the sinister AXIOM, which will stop at nothing to maintain its grip on power in this crumbling world.

Rise OF NEWBORNS is an single co-op multiplayer survival,Extraction game, with combine mechanics made by Single Developer.

Rise of The Newborns is a complex online sandbox Survival Extraction, where you fight for hope and the future - starting with survival. Find food, build shelter, craft tools and weapons. Then defend yourself against the monstrous Aegisborn, mutated victims of disease, before bringing the fight to AXIOM and discovering the true origins of VAS.

 

Wars taking place in the world had begun to damage the world. Pharmaceutical mafias began to invent new diseases in order to sell more medicine; yet, this was the last straw and humanity was coming close to an end. In 2028, scientists working for the pharmaceutical mafias created a new unknown virus and started an epidemic. This brought about infertility and many other diseases. But then they realised that they only had 20 years left to live due and that new born children were immune against this virus. They started to work on a cure, but it was too late. Those who were immune were named the “new-borns” and they finally accepted that this was going to be the beginning of a new era

Now in the year 2048, THE ERA OF THE NEWBORNS HAS BEGUN

purchase your own speical clothes and equipments but dont forget game have Area effect you must think and plan what and where you wear the that clothes for hot,cold,warm,toxic,radiation for backpacks have own slot and weight you must upgrade craft or find new backpacks for more carrying u can craft find dismantle your clothes choose is yours.

A World Worth Fighting For.

  •  Massive Open World — Up to 64km²

One vast survival map spanning up to 64 square kilometres, divided across 10 distinct regions each with its own biome, climate, hazards, and resources. More survival maps are planned for future updates.

  •  Choose Your Nationality

At the start, you select your nationality — each one comes with its own unique advantages and disadvantages. Where you're from shapes how you survive. No two playthroughs begin the same way.

  •  Travel Between Worlds

You are not locked to one location. Travel to any map at any time — but it comes at a cost. Resources are required to make the journey, and you must prepare accordingly. Different environments demand different gear, supplies, and strategies. Arrive unprepared and the world will make you regret it.

  •  Extraction Maps

Currently 1 extraction maps are available — high-risk zones where you drop in, loot, and fight to get out alive. More extraction maps are coming with future updates. Every run is a gamble. Every successful extraction is earned.

  •  Hideout

Your personal safe zone and home base. The Hideout is where everything comes together — access your main stash, craft at dedicated workbenches, trade with specific NPC traders, and prepare for your next run. Doors leading directly to extraction maps and survival anytime open from here. Upgrade and expand your Hideout over time by investing items and resources, making it more efficient, better equipped, and uniquely yours.

  •  The Null

These were once people — ordinary survivors who couldn't overcome the VAS virus. The infection didn't kill them. It transformed them. Stripped of reason and identity, the Null exist in a state of pure instinct — relentless, unpredictable, and dangerous in numbers. They are what happens when humanity loses the fight from the inside.

  •  Rogue Newborns

Not every Newborn chose the right path. Some, corrupted by desperation and the intoxication of power, turned against their own kind. These rogue Newborns are as capable as you are — immune, skilled, and ruthless. They don't follow orders. They take what they want, and they have long stopped caring who gets hurt in the process.

  •  Aegis Tech — AXIOM's Military Arm

Organized, heavily equipped, and operating under direct orders from AXIOM, Aegis Tech soldiers are the most tactically dangerous threat you will face. They control critical infrastructure, patrol high-value zones, and actively hunt Newborns. This isn't personal for them — it's protocol. But the result is the same: they will not stop until you're neutralized.

Current Features

  • Multiplayer — Play solo or jump into other players' servers.

  • Hideout — Live in Hideout Upgrade an enjoy or u can live on survival map.

  • Trading System — u can Buy Sell your items in Hideout or Living areas on Survival Map. Sometimes they can be have interesting items or Stolen items

  • Deep and Advanced S — A living world with wildlife. Hunt deer and interact with the natural environment.

  • Loot System

    Over 800 unique items are waiting to be found, fought for, and lost. Loot is everywhere — scattered across the world in containers and crates, dropped from the bodies of every enemy you kill, and falling from the sky in high-value airdrops that draw attention from anyone nearby.

    Rarity Tiers

    Every item in the world belongs to one of seven rarity tiers — each one representing a step up in power, scarcity, and value:

    • Common — The backbone of survival. Found everywhere, useful always.

    • Uncommon — A cut above. Worth picking up, worth holding onto.

    • Rare — Not easy to find. Noticeably better. Other players will want what you're carrying.

    • Epic — Serious gear for serious situations. A good Epic find can change a run.

    • Legendary — Exceptional. Hard to find, harder to replace. Lose it and you'll feel it.

    • Mythical — Near impossible to obtain. The kind of item people remember finding.

    • ⬡ Aegis Tech — Beyond Mythical. Exclusive equipment belonging to AXIOM's military arm. The rarest, most powerful items in the world — and the most dangerous to chase.

    Where Loot Lives

    • Containers & Crates — Scattered across every map. Search thoroughly — the best finds are never in the obvious places.

    • Enemy Bodies — Every Null, Rogue Newborn, and Aegis Tech soldier drops loot on death. The harder the enemy, the better the reward.

    • Airdrops — High-value supply drops that land without warning. Move fast — you won't be the only one heading for it.

    Extraction Risk

    In extraction maps, death is not just a setback — it's a loss. Every item you carried in stays where you fell. Other players can find your body and take everything

  • Deep Crafting System — Craft unique items across various specialized workbenches Or Inventory

  • Custom Consumable Animations - Every Medical or Consumable anim has own Unique animaton so u can feel realism

  • Gore - Dismembered System - u can Gore Nulls from Head or any Body Parts Satisfiying to Killing Threats

  • Advanced Weapon  - Attachment System - u Can customize your weapons ammo mag Red dot etc so your weapon can be powerfull

  • Weapon Attachment System — Customize your weapons with attachments: silencers, scopes, grips, and more.

  • Suprise ingame Events - u can Find Realtime events to explore and get Unique items from Story

  • Fast Travel & Teleport - u can Fast Travel with Quantum Leap Machines or u can Teleport fly to Extraction Maps from Hideout

  • Survival Mechanics — Hunger,Thirsty Stamina etc with Limb Based Health System so basicly u need to take your body safe.

  • Smelting & Alloy System — Smelt raw resources into bars and combine them into advanced alloys and materials.

  • Dynamic Building System — Construct shelters and bases with upgradeable tiers for increased protection. Currently upgradeable to Brick tier.

  • Weapon System — Advanced damage mechanics built for both PvE and PvP encounters.

  • Building Tier Expansion — At least 3 new upgrade tiers planned beyond Brick: Iron, Reinforced Iron, and Titanium.

  • Advanced Gathering System — Harvest a wide range of resources: wood, stone, iron, copper, magnesium, and more.

  • Temperature System — Survive not just enemies, but the environment itself. Prepare for extreme cold and heat.

  • Wild Nature System — A living world with wildlife. Hunt deer and interact with the natural environment.

  • Live Environment — A living world with Nulls,Soldiers.Explore World Develop your Character

  • Cooking System — Prepare meals from gathered ingredients to keep yourself fed and buffed.

  • Hunger & Thirst System — Monitor your food and water levels. Neglect them at your own risk.

  • Newborn Perks — Earn a perk every level. Choose your path: Crafter, Scientist, Soldier, and more — shaped by your nationality.

  • Clothing & Gear System — Equip a wide range of wearable items: outfits, glasses, masks, and specialized gear each with unique properties.

  • Market System — Sell your resources for coins and use them to purchase items from the in-game market.

  • Day & Night Cycle + Season System — A dynamic world that changes with time and season, affecting gameplay and strategy.

  • Farming System — Grow your own crops. Cook them, trade them, or stockpile them for harder times.

  • Robots & Drones — Encounter various types of AI-controlled robots and drones — aggressive, territorial, and not to be underestimated.

  • Driving System — Find, repair, and refuel vehicles. Upgrade your car with different designs and abilities.

  • Expanded Vehicle Roster — More cars, a system to acquire and craft vehicle gear, and full multiplayer car travel with friends.

In Development — Coming With Updates

  • Personal Trade Posts — Set up your own trading post and sell items to other players in real time through the in-game market.

  • Taming System — Tame wild animals and take control of robots. Put them to work or send them into battle.

  • Nationality System — Choose your nationality at the start and gain unique advantages and disadvantages that shape your entire playthrough.

  • Pet System — Acquire companions to fight alongside you or carry your supplies.

  • More Robots & Drones — Additional types with more aggressive and varied AI behavior.

We are committed to continuous improvement based on your feedback. Join our Discord to stay up to date with all the latest news and development updates.

Dont Hesitate the Join Us

Discord: discordgg/riseofnewborns

Mail:  info@dodigamestudios.com

data.short_description: In a dystopian world consumed by the VAS, become one of the Newborn: A new generation of humans immune to the plague, surviving the ravages of disease, mutants, and sinister AXIOM. Fight for hope, rise against the odds, and pave the way for society to be reborn in a unique online sandbox RPG.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (64bit)
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen 5 3600 or Intel Core i5-10400F
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1650 or Radeon RX 580
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 35 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11 (64bit)
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen 7 5600X or Intel Core i7-11700F
  • Memory: 16 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3060 or AMD Radeon RX 6700 or Intel Arc A750
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 40 GB available space

content_descriptors.notes: Rise Of The Newborns has brutal combat where you can cut off limbs and heads of some opponents and blood is shown frequently.
